comment: Read against the maker's source at tag v2.6.13, commit 00f3497, which is the installed version; the branch has since moved to 2.6.14. Three manuals were used alongside it: the repository README, docs/modules/Metriks/Manual.md, and docs/modules/RKD/Manual.pdf, an 18-page PDF read with pypdf. Every module in the plugin carries a Model submenu offering Creamy, Stage Repro, Absolute Night, Dark "Signature", Deepblue "Signature" and Titanium "Signature", plus silver or gold jacks and screws to match; it changes nothing but appearance, so under the house rule it gets no line except on the six blank panels, where being looked at is the module's whole function. RKD and BRK do not have that submenu: they follow Rack's own Use dark panels if available setting instead. A new module of any other kind comes up as Absolute Night when that Rack setting is on and Creamy when it is off, and then keeps whichever model it was given. SHARED GROUND WITH OhmerPrems, which publishes no source and is not in this batch: KlokSpid MkII in that plugin is the direct successor to this KlokSpid and the README says it is free and unlimited, so the SETUP system described here, the encoder-plus-button interface, the 31-entry ratio list and the output-level choices are the conventions to expect there. The six-model theme scheme and the silver-or-gold jack swap are almost certainly shared too, and the same house rule should leave them out of the lines. The RKD and BRK pairing may recur as well, since OhmerPrems continues the same maker's expander habits.
